appearanceOptions.label: Appearance
appearanceOptions.description: Change the light/dark mode to match your viewing preference. This does not affect the view for others.

borderOptions.label: Borders
borderOptions.description: Apply borders to the selected cells.

calculationOptions.label: Calculation Options
calculationOptions.description: Choose when formulas are recalculated and how circular references are resolved.

cellsFormatOptions.description: Change row and column sizes or visibility, or open the Format Cells pane.
cellsFormatOptions.label: Format

clearOptions.description: Clear everything in the cell, or remove just the formatting or contents.
clearOptions.label: Clear

commentOptions.label: Comment
commentOptions.description: Add, show, and move between the comments on the sheet.

conditionalFormatOptions.label: Conditional Formatting
conditionalFormatOptions.description: Easily spot trends and patterns in your data using bars, colors and icons to visually highlight important values.

conditionalFormatHighlightOptions.label: Highlight Cells Rules
conditionalFormatHighlightOptions.description: Highlight cells that match a condition.

conditionalFormatTopBottomOptions.label: Top/Bottom Rules
conditionalFormatTopBottomOptions.description: Highlight the highest or lowest ranked values.

dataValidationOptions.label: Data Validation
dataValidationOptions.description: Limit what can be entered in cells, and mark the values that break the rules.

darkModeOptions.description: Options available when in dark mode
darkModeOptions.label: Dark Mode Option

dataTextToColumnsOptions.description: Split a single columns of text into multiple columns
dataTextToColumnsOptions.label: Text to Columns

deleteCellsOptions.description:
Delete cells, rows, columns or sheets from your workbook.
To delete multiple rows or columns at a time, select multiple rows or columns in the sheet and click Delete.

deleteSheetOptions.description:
Delete cells, rows, columns or sheets from your workbook.
To delete multiple rows or columns at a time, select multiple rows or columns in the sheet and click Delete.

fileOptions.description: Options for saving and loading the workbook.
fileOptions.label: File

fillOptions.description: Fill the selected cells with the value from one of the corners.
fillOptions.label: Fill

filterOptions.label: Filter
filterOptions.description:
Organize your data so it's easier to analyze.
You can sort the selected data from smallest to largest or largest to smallest.

findOptions.description: Find and replace cells or go to a specific location.
findOptions.label: Find & Select

formatCells.label: Format Cells
formatCells.description: Change how the selected cells look — number, alignment, font, fill and borders.

freezeOptions.description:
Freeze a portion of the sheet to keep it visible while you scroll through the rest of the sheet.

Useful for viewing data in other parts of your worksheet without losing your headers or labels.
freezeOptions.label: Freeze Panes

gridlinesOptions.description: Configure how the lines between rows and columns in the sheet are displayed.
gridlinesOptions.label: Gridlines

headingsOptions.description: Configure how the column and rows headings in the sheet are displayed.
headingsOptions.label: Headings

groupOptions.label: Group
groupOptions.description:
Group rows or columns so they can be collapsed and expanded together.
Select entire rows or columns and click Group, or choose which from the menu.

horizontalAlignOptions.description: Configure how text is placed in the horizontal direction of the cell.
horizontalAlignOptions.label: Horizontal Alignment

insertCellsOptions.description:
Insert new cells, rows or columns to your workbook.
To insert multiple rows or columns at a time, select multiple rows or columns in the sheet and click Insert.

insertChartOptions.label: Insert Chart
insertChartOptions.description: Add a chart to visualize the selected data.

insertDataOptions.description: Import a file or web workbook and add its sheets as new tabs.
insertDataOptions.label: Import Data

insertCellControlOptions.description: Insert a checkbox, or another registered cell control, in the selected cells.

insertImageInCellOptions.label: Place in Cell
insertImageInCellOptions.description: Insert a picture as the value of the selected cell. It moves, sorts and filters with the cell.

insertImageOptions.label: Pictures
insertImageOptions.description: Insert a picture in a cell or over the cells.

insertImageOverCellsOptions.label: Place over Cells
insertImageOverCellsOptions.description: Insert a picture that floats over the cells. It can be moved and resized on its own.

insertSheetOptions.description:
Insert new cells, rows or columns to your workbook.
To insert multiple rows or columns at a time, select multiple rows or columns in the sheet and click Insert.

insertSparklineOptions.label: Sparklines
insertSparklineOptions.description: Draw a small chart of the selected data in the cells beside it.

languageOptions.label: Language & Region
languageOptions.description: Choose the language for the interface, and the regional formatting used by this workbook.

managedNames.label: Names
managedNames.description: Define and manage the names used in place of addresses in formulas.

pasteOptions.description: Add content to the clipboard to your document.
pasteOptions.label: Paste

protectionOptions.description: Protect the sheet, choose what stays editable, and manage workbook protection.

sheetBackgroundOptions.description: Tile a picture behind the sheet's cells. A background is shown on screen only — it is never printed.
sheetBackgroundOptions.label: Background

sheetZoomOptions.label: Zoom
sheetZoomOptions.description: Set the zoom level of the current sheet.

sortFilterOptions.label: Sort & Filter
sortFilterOptions.description:
Organize your data so it's easier to analyze.
You can sort the selected data from smallest to largest or largest to smallest.

sortOptions.label: Sort
sortOptions.description:
Organize your data so it's easier to analyze.
You can sort the selected data from smallest to largest or largest to smallest.

sparklineMarkerColorOptions.label: Marker Color
sparklineMarkerColorOptions.description: Color the points the sparklines highlight.

sparklineOptions.label: Sparklines
sparklineOptions.description: Edit or clear the sparklines of the selected cells.

textEffectsOptions.description: Style your text to differentiate it.
textEffectsOptions.label: Text Effects

textOverflowOptions.description: Configure how text behaves when it doesn't fit within a cell.
textOverflowOptions.label: Text Overflow

textRotateOptions.description: Rotate your text diagonally or vertically. This is a great way to label narrow columns.
textRotateOptions.label: Text Orientation

ungroupOptions.label: Ungroup
ungroupOptions.description: Remove rows or columns from their group.

verticalAlignOptions.description: Configure how text is placed in the vertical direction of the cell.
verticalAlignOptions.label: Vertical Alignment

workbookViewOptions.description: Options to configure how the workbook is displayed.
workbookViewOptions.label: Workbook View
